command_limits.entrypoint_override: /usr/local/bin/python; avoid the image's default second Xvfb/Openbox startup

construction_delta: Distinct successor allocation after predecessor preflight STOP. Add two real X11 client windows and explicitly observe per-window KeyPress/KeyRelease delivery during a positive-control pulse and a focus transfer while the same XTEST key remains down; T3 only observed XQueryKeymap state. Pin image by pre/post host docker image inspect and --pull=never; candidate reads digest from freeze instead of environment injection.

decision_gates.pass: PASS_X11_APP_DELIVERY_BOUNDARY_SCOPED only when the focused positive control delivers both W events with false/true/false keymap state, and during transfer A receives W KeyPress, the global W bit remains true after B becomes focus, but B receives zero W KeyPress before release; identities, full bitmaps, event order, and private-server cleanup must audit.
decision_gates.fail: FAIL if frozen expected event/focus/keymap relationships contradict the raw record.
decision_gates.stop: STOP if source/image identity, Xvfb startup, one-shot run, raw retention, or cleanup is incomplete.
decision_gates.scope: Virtual XTEST/Xvfb protocol evidence only; no physical input, semantic app effect, game, model, MAP01, safety, latency, or efficacy claim.
